docs.abstract: Fear of being seen as circumventing an open nomination process is one reason that some backers have not yet publicly endorsed the vice president.

byline.original: By Andrew Ross Sorkin, Ravi Mattu, Bernhard Warner, Sarah Kessler, Michael J. de la Merced, Lauren Hirsch and Ephrat Livni

headline.main: Why Some Donors Are Holding Back on Endorsing Harris (for Now)

multimedia.caption: Vice President Kamala Harris has secured the backing of most leading Democrats and big donors, but some worry that going too fast could backfire with voters.

docs.snippet: Fear of being seen as circumventing an open nomination process is one reason that some backers have not yet publicly endorsed the vice president.
